description: Fix Hindi motivational quotes ticker visibility on Agent and TL pages. Also add getSmartRemarks() personalized Hindi leaderboard remarks to TL page leaderboards.
steps: In public/agent/index.html: Move <script src='/quotes-agent.js'></script> BEFORE the inline script that defines setAgentQuotes(). Remove the premature setAgentQuotes() call. Keep only one call after the script is loaded.
In public/agent/index.html: Add setAgentQuotes() call inside showDialer() function to re-apply quotes after login when the element becomes visible.
In public/tl/index.html: Remove premature setTLQuotes()/setTLAQuotes() calls from inline script block (they were called before external scripts loaded, doing nothing).
In public/tl/index.html: Add setTLQuotes() and setTLAQuotes() calls to showTLDashboard() for post-login rendering.
In public/tl/index.html: Add getSmartRemarks() function with Hindi motivational remarks for leaderboard positions.
In public/tl/index.html: Integrate remarks into both renderTLLeaderboard() and renderAgentLeaderboard() functions.
acceptance_criteria: Quotes ticker is visible and animated on Agent page after login
Quotes ticker is visible and animated on TL page in both TL mode and Agent mode
TL leaderboard (TL mode) shows personalized Hindi smart remarks per agent row
Agent leaderboard (Agent mode in TL page) shows personalized Hindi smart remarks per agent row
All script blocks parse without syntax errors
Updated ZIP file is created at /projects/sandbox/Cluade/ruralift-crm-updated.zip
verification: All inline script blocks in HTML files parse correctly via new Function()
ZIP file created with all updated files
findings: The root cause was script loading order: setAgentQuotes() was called before quotes-agent.js was loaded (making agentQuotes undefined), and the same issue existed in TL page. Fixed by ensuring external scripts load first. Also added quote-setting calls to login functions. TL page leaderboards already had the structure but lacked getSmartRemarks - added it with the same Hindi motivational messages as the admin page.
